experimental_method: Gas-volumetric absorption method with pure oxygen (99.995%) at 1 atm O2 partial pressure and 15, 25, 35 C in aqueous solutions of 11 electrolytes; solution concentrations analysed (titration, Mohr, chelate, oxine methods).
uncertainties_stated: Pure-water check: mean Ostwald coefficient 0.03643 at 15 C (mean deviation 0.49%), 0.03114 at 25 C (18 points, 0.32%), 0.02764 at 35 C (7 points, 0.39%), agreeing with literature.
quality_remarks: NaOH samples contained 1-2% Na2CO3 (ignored; concentration given as total Na expressed as NaOH). Paper in Japanese; table headings in English. Cs is molarity per litre of solution. Authors' comparison: NaOH about 10% below Geffcken at 2 mol/l. Printed table value 0.008C0 (NaOH, 25 C, 3.613 mol/l) is a scan glitch, read as 0.00800.
not_extracted_tables: Table 2 (journal p. 187): observed salting-out parameters K and van Krevelen-Hoftijzer estimates: derived and estimated quantities.
Table 3: parameters of Eq. (7) (fit coefficients): model parameters.

row_counts.table_1: printed 181 data rows (23 NaOH, 30 KCl, 23 Na2CO3, 8 NaNO3, 7 BaCl2, 13 CaCl2, 7 Ca(NO3)2, 29 MgSO4 at 15/25 C, 10 MgCl2, 12 AlCl3, 11 MgSO4 at 35 C, 8 Al2(SO4)3); written 181 plus 12 label rows
